content:
Priya (ProdMktg): Experiment idea: webinar follow-up bundle — 50 starter credits + 3-prompt 'Launch Pack' injected in product. Goal: lift D7 activation and time-to-first-demo. Need short playbook + metrics.

Aisha (Growth): Love it. Quick factorial: credits 50 vs 100; pack vs no-pack; CTA variant. Keep run 2 weeks.

Tom - Content: I'll write three micro-nudges: immediate with recording + CTA, how-to modal text, 48h tips. Short, action-focused.

Leif (DevEx): We can inject pack via internal API and show a one-time modal with "Run sample now". I'll QA web + desktop.

Evan (Data): I'll pull baselines for last 4 webinars: D0-D7 activation, median tokens. Will instrument events: webinar_attend, pack_injected, pack_used, tokens_24h. Dashboard ready by Wed.

Marco (Growth Ops): Routing: if user consumes >500 tokens OR completes >=5 prompts within 48h -> tag high-engage and create CS task. I'll wire Zapier + SF queue.

Priya (ProdMktg): Timeline: copy Tue, dev + QA Wed, launch Thu 09:00 PT aligned with followups. I'll own experiment flags and rollout.

Tom - Content: Dropping drafts to Drive in 2h.

Leif (DevEx): Quick note: credits expire in 30 days; include in copy and modal. Also add safe fallback banner if injection fails.

Evan (Data): Adding cohort tag webinar_lp_1839. Will provide MDE for splits.

Priya (ProdMktg): Cool. Final checklist: Tom copy, Leif injection + modal, Marco routing, Evan dashboard. Launch Thu.

Aisha (Growth): Also test CTA text: "Start with template" vs "Claim credits". Small but likely meaningful.

Priya (ProdMktg): Great — thanks all. I'll post a Loom with the playbook after copy review. :rocket:
